headline: Japan Day-Ahead Power Prices Jump to Highest Level Since August 2022
summary: Japan's day-ahead wholesale electricity price reached $0.24 per kilowatt-hour, up 6% week-on-week to hit its highest level since August 2022 due to colder weather forecasts.
why: Spot power prices in Japan reflect utility fuel import costs and grid supply margins during peak winter heating periods.
why_moved: Colder seasonal weather projections increased expected heating consumption across Japanese utility grids.
